from pathlib import Path
import json,shlex,subprocess,sys,datetime,shutil
assert Path.cwd()==Path('/home/cina/cinagroup/cinashop/view/uniapp-ts')
scripts=json.loads(Path('package.json').read_text())['scripts']
steps=['typecheck','test:toolchain','test:admzip','test:express-qs','test:jest-jsdom-once','test:d3-advisories','build:h5','build:mp-weixin','build:app','test:build-artifacts','test:automator-qr','test:runtime-i18n']
for name in steps:
    print('STEP '+name+' '+datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),flush=True)
    if name.startswith('build:'):
        target=Path('dist/build')/{'h5':'h5','mp-weixin':'mp-weixin','app':'app'}[name.split(':',1)[1]]
        assert not target.is_symlink() and target.resolve()==Path.cwd()/target
        if target.exists():shutil.rmtree(target)
        print('CLEAN '+str(target),flush=True)
    if name=='test:toolchain':
        args=shlex.split(scripts[name]); assert args[:2]==['node','--test']
        args[2:2]=['--test-concurrency=1','--test-reporter=tap']
    else: args=['npm','run',name]
    result=subprocess.run(args)
    if result.returncode: sys.exit(result.returncode)
print('STEP common-security '+datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),flush=True)
sys.exit(subprocess.run(['node','--test','--test-concurrency=1','../common/toolchain-security.test.mjs']).returncode)
